channel.title: Apache Software Foundation — recent CVEs
channel.description: Most recent CVEs assigned by Apache Software Foundation (apache).

item.title: CVE-2026-124324 — Apache Jena Fuseki: SERVICE bypasses localhost-only administration controls
item.description: A vulnerability in Apache Jena Fuseki allows SERVICE operations to bypass restrictions on administration operations. This issue affects Apache Jena Fuseki: from through 6.2.0. Users are recommended to upgrade to version 6.3.0, which fixes the issue.

item.title: CVE-2026-120502 — Apache Jena: Excess memory allocation from malicious Thrift data
item.description: A vulnerability in Apache Jena can cause excess memory allocation from malicious Thrift data. This issue affects Apache Jena: through 6.2.0. Users are recommended to upgrade to version 6.3.0, which fixes the issue.

item.title: CVE-2026-86155 · 10 CRITICAL 🌩️ — Apache Jena Fuseki: SHACL validation can cause SSRF in SHACL SPARQL targets
item.description: A vulnerability in Apache Jena Fuseki in the SHACL validation functionality cause server side request forgery (SSRF). This issue affects Apache Jena Fuseki: through 6.2.0. Users are recommended to upgrade to version 6.3.0, which fixes the issue.

item.title: CVE-2026-86154 — Apache Jena: Nested structures can lead to stack overflow in Turtle language syntax parsers
item.description: A vulnerability in Apache Jena allows arbitrary stack usage when parsing RDF Turtle-family languages. This issue affects Apache Jena: through 6.2.0. Users are recommended to upgrade to version 6.3.0, which fixes the issue.
